rules.1: Must not violate the laws or regulations of any country or region;
rules.2: No pornographic, violent, discriminatory, infringing, or illegal promotional content;
rules.3: Must reflect positive, uplifting values (blessings, vows, good wishes, etc.);
rules.4: Both images and text must pass review before being written on-chain and displayed;
rules.5: Content cannot be modified once on-chain; please check carefully before submitting.
help.selfBody: Connect a Phantom / Solflare / Backpack / OKX / MetaMask wallet. Every wish, like, and blessing is signed by you, and funds go directly from your wallet to the payee addresses. This site never touches your private key or holds funds.
help.hostBody: Entering an email generates a devnet-only key on the demo server, which signs on your behalf. The key is stored in plain text in a server file and must never be used for mainnet or real assets; production use would require KMS/HSM, identity verification, and a compliance assessment.
help.guestBody: Browse all wishes without logging in (read-only).
help.feeBody: The amount for a wish (custom card) is up to you, with a minimum of USD 1 worth of SOL (or equivalent on EVM). The full amount goes to the project's receive address for that chain; the wallet shows the recipient when you sign. Likes and blessings only cost the network fee. This project offers no returns, dividends, liquidity, or rebates of any kind.
help.modBody: Content is checked by the moderation service before payment / on-chain writing (keyword filter + AI semantic review interface + manual review queue). On approval, the service signs “content hash + result + timestamp” with ed25519, and the signature is written on-chain together with the content. The frontend re-verifies it when reading; content with a missing or invalid attestation is not displayed.
help.stageBody: The World Tree grows continuously with the number of wish cards (no final stage). Each month (Beijing time) it shifts form: days 1–10 {green}; days 11–20 {bloom}; day 21 to month end {fall}.
help.riskBody: This project is an MVP demo running on Solana devnet; test tokens have no value. On-chain content is public and cannot be deleted; this site can hide violating content in the frontend but cannot erase it from the chain.
terms.title: User Agreement / Purchase Terms
terms.1: This site is a non-custodial frontend: all writes are signed by your own wallet (or, in demo mode, by a devnet demo key), and the blockchain is the single source of truth.
terms.3: Custom card content you submit must comply with the Custom Card Content Policy:
terms.4: The purchase amount is up to you, with a minimum of USD 1 worth of SOL (or equivalent on EVM). Payment goes in full to the project's receive address for that chain; this site does not handle or hold funds and offers no returns, dividends, or rebates.
terms.5: Once on-chain, content and payments are irrevocable, unmodifiable, and non-refundable. Please check carefully before submitting.
terms.6: Each purchase creates a soul-bound “World Tree Spectrum” record bound to your address; it is non-transferable and has no financial attributes.
terms.7: Custodial demo mode is for devnet testing only and must not be used for real assets.
terms.8: Currently running on the devnet test network, for demonstration only.

help.socialBody: A social card lets you introduce yourself and meet like-minded people. The card text, tags (up to 5), intro and “looking for” are reviewed and then written publicly on-chain; they cannot be changed afterwards. Contact info is optional and stored only on this site’s server (off-chain), never on-chain; you can edit or delete it anytime under My Wishes › My cards, and choose whether to show it in the card details. Contact info is also moderated and checked against phishing lists. There is no matching, recommendation or direct messaging. Contact info is entered by the user; use your own judgment, as this site does not verify it.
help.giftBody: A gift card is a greeting card addressed to a specific address (Solana or EVM), with an optional note of up to 50 characters. The sender is the signing address; the recipient and note are written publicly on-chain. A gift card is only an on-chain display record: no tokens or assets are transferred and it carries no promise of redemption. The recipient can see it under My Wishes › Gifts received after signing in, and gets an inbox notice (if enabled). Blocked addresses cannot receive gift cards.

help.gateBody: A gate card is only an online access credential: not an asset, non-transferable (soulbound), no physical card, no promise of returns, and holding one confers no ownership. Gate cards can be issued by rules (you claim them once the conditions are met) or by an issuer, may have an expiry, and can be revoked by the issuer or an administrator. Names and benefit descriptions must pass positive-content review.
terms.9: A gate card is only an online access credential: not an asset, non-transferable, with no promise of returns or ownership. Issuers may set an expiry or revoke it, and gate card text must pass positive-content review.

If the card expires or is revoked, Treehole locks again.
